chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from al-Hasan ibn Musa from Ghiyath ibn Kalub from Isḥaq ibn 'Ammar from Ja'far from his father (peace be upon them both)
That 'Ali (peace be upon him) disliked Hajj and 'Umrah on the large/heavy camels. And whoever performs Hajj via the route of Iraq, it is preferable that he begin with al-Madinah. He narrated.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on performing Hajj on large camels and the preferred starting point for the Iraqi route?
ai.summary: Imam 'Ali (peace be upon him) preferred performing Hajj and 'Umrah on 'jalalat' (large, sturdy) camels, reflecting a scholarly view that emphasizes the comfort and dignity of the pilgrim during the journey. Furthermore, for those traveling via the Iraqi route, it is recommended to begin their pilgrimage from al-Madinah, highlighting the spiritual significance of visiting the Prophet's tomb before proceeding to Mecca.
